## Open-source software

### Anthropic Skill Creator

Study how a reusable skill packages instructions and evaluation for a repeatable agent task.

- **Publisher** Anthropic
- **Category** Agent skills
- **Difficulty** Advanced
- **Access** Free. Example skill source. Runtime and model access are separate. [Access evidence](<https://github.com/anthropics/skills>)
- **Status** Recent repository activity (2026-11-16). [Status evidence](<https://github.com/anthropics/skills>)
- **Reviewed** 2026-11-19
- **License** Apache-2.0. The named skill under skills/skill-creator. Review licensing of other folders and the runtime individually. [License terms](<https://github.com/anthropics/skills/blob/main/skills/skill-creator/LICENSE.txt>) · [OSI listing](<https://opensource.org/license/apache-2.0>)

[Official resource](<https://github.com/anthropics/skills/tree/main/skills/skill-creator>) · [Public repository](<https://github.com/anthropics/skills>) · [Handbook exercise](<../agents.md>)

### GTM AI Buyer Readiness

Audit published buyer-facing HTML, structured data, feeds, and advertised capability information with offline sample reports.

- **Publisher** Useful in Practice
- **Category** Libraries and CLIs
- **Difficulty** Intermediate
- **Access** Free. Repository and offline examples. Live use requires permission to crawl the target. [Access evidence](<https://github.com/stephenstilwell/gtm-ai-buyer-readiness>)
- **Status** Recent repository activity (2026-11-19). [Status evidence](<https://github.com/stephenstilwell/gtm-ai-buyer-readiness>)
- **Reviewed** 2026-11-19
- **License** MIT. Repository code and its audit implementation. [License terms](<https://github.com/stephenstilwell/gtm-ai-buyer-readiness/blob/main/LICENSE>) · [OSI listing](<https://opensource.org/license/mit>)

[Official resource](<https://github.com/stephenstilwell/gtm-ai-buyer-readiness>) · [Handbook exercise](<../build/commerce.md>)

[Official resource](<https://github.com/stephenstilwell/gtm-signal-lab>) · [Handbook exercise](<../build/routing.md>)

### jq

### Node-RED

- **Reviewed** 2026-11-19
- **License** Apache-2.0. Core Node-RED repository. Check separately installed nodes individually. [License terms](<https://github.com/node-red/node-red/blob/main/LICENSE>) · [OSI listing](<https://opensource.org/license/apache-2.0>)

[Official resource](<https://github.com/node-red/node-red>) · [Handbook exercise](<../signals.md>)

[Official resource](<https://github.com/openai/openai-agents-python>) · [Handbook exercise](<../agents.md>)

## Source-available software

### n8n

Connect triggers and system actions with editable workflow steps that operators can inspect and replay.

- **Publisher** n8n
- **Category** Workflow automation
- **Difficulty** Intermediate
- **Access** Freemium. Self-hosted community use is subject to the license. Hosted and enterprise options are paid. [Access evidence](<https://n8n.io/pricing/>)
- **Status** Recent repository activity (2026-11-19). [Status evidence](<https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n>)
- **Reviewed** 2026-11-19
- **License** Sustainable Use License and n8n Enterprise License. Community self-hosting and enterprise files have separate terms. Review permitted use before operating for third parties. [License terms](<https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/blob/master/LICENSE.md>)

[Official resource](<https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n>) · [Handbook exercise](<../workflows.md>)

### Metabase

- **Category** Revenue analytics
- **Difficulty** Intermediate
- **Access** Freemium. Free self-hosted open-source edition and paid cloud or enterprise editions. [Access evidence](<https://www.metabase.com/pricing>)
